original: vajraṃ ghaṇṭāṃ ca mudrāṃ gurumapi śirasā dhārayāmīṣṭavajre vajrakule sthita idaṃ samayaṃ gṛhṇāmi /

original: jinavarasamayaṃ pālayāmyatra cakre cakrakule sthitaḥ pañcāmṛtādyaṃ gokudahanaṃ skandhendriyasamūhaṃ rakṣāmīti praṇidhānam /

original: sattvānāṃ mokṣahetorjinajanakakula ekaśūkavajre sthitaḥ san bodhimutpādayāmi śūnyatākaruṇā tmikāṃ mahāmudrāsiddhimiti praṇidhānaṃ karomi /

original: snāto gandhānulipto vrataniyamayutaḥ pūrvabhūmyāṃ niveśya siddhyarthaṃ dantakāṣṭhaṃ jinavarakuliśaiścābhimantrya pradeyam /

original: iha mantrayāne pāramitāyāne ca dvidhā yogābhyāsaḥ /
analyzed: iha mantra yāne pāramitā yāne ca dvidhā yoga abhyāsaḥ
ākāśe yoga abhyāsaḥ bhyavakāśe ca

original: ya ākāśe yogamāpsyate sa rātrau niśchidragṛhe 'ndhakāra ākāśāsaktacittaḥ sarvacintāparihāreṇa śūnya ekāgramanaḥ kṛtvā dinamekaṃ parīkṣayed dhūmādikaṃ nimittaṃ paśyatyanimiṣanayano vajramārgaṃ praviṣṭa iti /
analyzed: yaḥ ākāśe yogam āpsyate sa rātrau niśchidra gṛhe ndhakāre ākāśa āsakta cittaḥ sarva cintā parihāreṇa śūnyaḥ ekāgra manaḥ kṛtvā dinam ekam parīkṣayet dhūma ādikam nimittam paśyati animiṣa nayanaḥ vajra mārgam praviṣṭaḥ iti

original: iha madhyamāprāṇapraviṣṭaḥ śūnyādevākāśāsaktacittairanimiṣanayanairvajramārgapraviṣṭaiḥ śūnyāddhūmo marīciḥ prakaṭavimalakhadyota eva pradīpa iti niśāyogena paśyati /
analyzed: iha madhyamā prāṇa praviṣṭaḥ śūnyāt eva ākāśa āsakta cittaiḥ animiṣa nayanaiḥ vajra mārga praviṣṭaiḥ śūnyāt dhūmaḥ marīciḥ prakaṭa vimala khadyotaḥ eva pradīpaḥ iti niśā yogena paśyati
tatas nirabhram gaganam paśyati

original: tato gaganāt punardivāyogena gaganodbhavaḥ svayambhūḥ prajñājñānānalo mahāniti jvālā dṛśyate nirabhre gagane /
analyzed: tatas gaganāt punar divā yogena gagana udbhavaḥ svayambhūḥ prajñā jñāna analaḥ mahān iti jvālā dṛśyate nirabhre gagane
evam vairocanaḥ mahā dīptiḥ jñāna jyotiḥ virocanaḥ candra ābhāsaḥ
mahā tejāḥ prabhāsvaraḥ vidyut parama kalā iti

original: vidyārājo 'gramantreśo binduka iti daśadhā nimittaṃ samājādau rātriyogena /
analyzed: vidyārājaḥ gra mantreśaḥ bindukaḥ iti daśadhā nimittam samāja ādau rātri yogena
nāmasaṅgītyām divāyogena sandhyā bhāṣā antareṇa bhagavatā uktam
tatas mantrarājaḥ mahā artha kṛt iti sarvakāram ghaṭa paṭa ādi bimba darśanam iti

original: tanmadhye bindumadhye buddhabimbaṃ viṣayavirahitaṃ draṣṭavyābhāvāt kalpanābhāvāccānekasambhogakāyam /
analyzed: tad madhye bindu madhye buddha bimbam viṣaya virahitam draṣṭavya abhāvāt kalpanā bhāvāt ca aneka sambhoga kāyam
tatas bimba yogena anāhata dhvaniḥ ya sa śrūyate
evam nirmāṇa kāyaḥ rūpa avabhāsataḥ
śabda avabhāsataḥ sambhoga kāyaḥ iti arthaḥ

original: ākāśaṃ stabdhadṛṣṭyā jaladhararahitaṃ yoginālokanīyaṃ yāvadvai kṛṣṇarekhā sphuradamalakarā dṛśyate kālanāḍyām /

original: tasyāṃ sarvajñabimbaṃ payasi ravirivānā ilaṃ viśvavarṇaṃ sarvākāraṃ svacittaṃ viṣayavirahitaṃ nāparaṃ cittameva //
analyzed: tasyām sarvajña bimbam payasi raviḥ iva anāḥ ilam viśva varṇam sarva ākāram sva cittam viṣaya virahitam na aparam cittam eva

original: atra. divāyoga ākāśaṃ stabdhadṛṣṭyā jaladhararahitaṃ yoginālokanīyaṃ pūrvāhṇe 'parāhṇe ca raveḥ pṛṣṭhaṃ dattvā /
analyzed: atra divāyoge ākāśam stabdha dṛṣṭyā jaladhara rahitam yoginā ālokanīyam pūrvāhṇe parāhṇe ca raveḥ pṛṣṭham dattvā
anyathā ravi raśmibhiḥ timiram bhavati

original: tena tadbādhāt pratidinamavalokanīyaṃ yāvad bindumadhye kṛṣṇarekhā bālapramāṇā sphuradamalakarā dṛśyate /

original: kālanāḍyāmavadhūtyāmantarbhūtaṃ sarvajñabimbaṃ traidhātukamaśeṣaṃ payasi ravirivānā ilaṃ viśvavarṇaṃ sarvākāraṃ svacittaṃ viṣayavirahitaṃ nāparaṃ cittameva /
analyzed: kālanāḍyām avadhūtyām antarbhūtam sarvajña bimbam traidhātukam aśeṣam payasi raviḥ iva anā ilam viśva varṇam sarva ākāram sva cittam viṣaya virahitam na aparam cittam eva
para cittam na bhavati para citta jñāna abhāvataḥ

original: tatra prathamaṃ svacittābhāso māṃsacakṣuṣā tathāgatasya dṛśyate divyādicakṣuṣā paracittajñānaṃ dṛśyate tena dharmasaṃgraha uktāni pañcacakṣūṃṣi bhagavata iti /
analyzed: tatra prathamam sva citta ābhāsaḥ māṃsa cakṣuṣā tathāgatasya dṛśyate divya ādi cakṣuṣā para citta jñānam dṛśyate tena dharma saṃgrahe uktāni pañca cakṣūṃṣi bhagavataḥ iti
evam jñāna kramāt māṃsacakṣuḥ divyacakṣuḥ buddhacakṣuḥ prajñācakṣuḥ jñānacakṣuḥ bhāvanā balena bhaviṣyati
tatas dṛṣṭam na kiñcid asti sarvajñasya iti
evaṃvidhaḥ ca ṣaḍaṅga yogaḥ ārya vajrapāṇi pādaiḥ api uktaḥ
iha pratyāhāraḥ bāhya rūpra ādi viṣayeṣu apravṛttiḥ cakṣuḥ ādi indriyaiḥ cakṣuḥ vijñāna ādīnām adhyātmani viṣayeṣu pravṛttiḥ divya cakṣuḥ ādi indriyaiḥ divya cakṣuḥ vijñāna ādīnām iti

original: adhyātmani śūnyatāālambanenākalpitaṃ sarvabhāvadarśanaṃ śūnye pratisenādarśanaṃ kumārikāyā iveti pratyāhārāṅgaṃ traidhātukabuddhabimbadarśanāditi /
analyzed: adhyātmani śūnyatā ālambanena a kalpitam sarva bhāva darśanam śūnye prati senā darśanam kumārikāyāḥ iva iti pratyāhāra aṅgam traidhātuka buddha bimba darśanāt iti

original: tato dhyānaṃ nāma śūnyeṣu sarvadharmeṣu dṛṣṭeṣu satsu /
analyzed: tatas dhyānam nāma śūnyeṣu sarva dharmeṣu dṛṣṭeṣu satsu
prajñā nāma teṣu citta pravṛttiḥ
vitarkaḥ nāma bhāva grahaṇam cittasya
vicāraḥ nāma bhāva grahaṇa pratipattiḥ
ratiḥ nāma sarva bhāveṣu citta āropaṇam
acala sukham nāma sarva bhāvebhyaḥ sukha sampattiḥ
evam pañcadhā dhyāna aṅgam
tatas prāṇāyāmaḥ nāma lalanā rasanā bāma dakṣiṇa mārga nirodhaḥ
avadhūtī madhya mārge prāṇa vāyoḥ sadā pravṛttiḥ iti

original: pūrakakumbhakarecakayogenāvadhūtyām oṃkāreṇa śvāsaṃ hūṃkāreṇa nirodhamāḥkāreṇa niḥśvāsaṃ candrasūryarrāhusvabhāvena kurute yogīti prāṇāyāmāṅgam /
analyzed: pūraka kumbhaka recaka yogena avadhūtyām oṃkāreṇa śvāsam hūṃkāreṇa nirodha māḥkāreṇa niḥśvāsam candra sūrya rrāhu svabhāvena kurute yogī iti prāṇāyāma aṅgam

original: tato dhāraṇā nāma prāṇasya mahendravāruṇāgnivāyumaṇḍale nābhau hṛdi kaṇṭhe lalāṭe praveśo bāhye 'nirgamaḥ /

bindau prāṇa praveśanam iti dhāraṇa aṅgam
tatas nusmṛtiḥ nāma sva iṣṭadevatā darśanam pratibimba ākāram vikalpa sahitam

tatas neka ākāra sphurat rūpam traidhātuka spharaṇam iti anusmṛti aṅgam

original: tataḥ samādhirnāmiṣṭadevatānurāgād yadakṣarasukhaprāptistasyāmekīkaraṇaṃ cittasya grāhyagrāhakarahitaṃ cittaṃ samādhyaṅgamucyate tathāgataiḥ /
analyzed: tatas samādhiḥ nāma iṣṭadevatā anurāgāt yat akṣara sukha prāptiḥ tasyām ekīkaraṇam cittasya grāhya grāhaka rahitam cittam samādhi aṅgam ucyate tathāgataiḥ

original: iha śrīsamājottare sevopasādhanaṃ sādhanaṃ mahāsādhanaṃ ceti /
analyzed: iha śrī samājottare sevā upasādhanam sādhanam mahāsādhanam ca iti

original: tadeva bhagavānaha sevākāle mahoṣṇīṣabimbaṃ vibhāvya yatnataḥ /
analyzed: tat eva bhagavān aha sevā kāle mahā uṣṇīṣa bimbam vibhāvya yatnataḥ

original: atra sandhyābhāṣāntareṇoṣṇīṣabimbaṃ buddhabimbaṃ traidhātukamaśeṣata ākāśe dharmodaye cittavajraṃ pratiṣṭhāpya sevākāle prathamakāle pratyāhāreṇa bhāvayed dhyānāṅgena sthirīkuryāditi /
analyzed: atra sandhyā bhāṣā antareṇa uṣṇīṣa bimbam buddha bimbam traidhātukam aśeṣatas ākāśe dharma udaye citta vajram pratiṣṭhāpya sevā kāle prathama kāle pratyāhāreṇa bhāvayet dhyāna aṅgena sthirīkuryāt iti

original: tatra gurūpadeśenākāśe prathamaṃ yogī dhūmaṃ paśyati na marīcikāmiti svānubhavato jñeyam /
analyzed: tatra guru upadeśena ākāśe prathamam yogī dhūmam paśyati na marīcikām iti sva anubhavataḥ jñeyam

original: evaṃ prathamaṃ dhūmanimittaṃ dvitīyaṃ marīcikānimittaṃ tṛtīyaṃ khadyotanimittaṃ caturthaṃ pradīpanimittaṃ pañcamaṃ nirabhragaganasannibhaṃ nimittamiti samājottare ḍākinīvajrapañjare 'pi bhagavatoktam /

analyzed: sarva cintām parityajya dinam ekam parīkṣayet pratyayam iti bhagavataḥ vacana viheṭhakāḥ

atas ṣaṣ aṅga yogāt dhūma ādikam nimittam bhavati iti

original: tathā ḍākinīvajrapañjare bhagavānāha ṣaḍaṅgaṃ bhāvayet tasmāt svādhiṣṭhānasamaṃ punaḥ /

original: atra svādhiṣṭhānaṃ nāma saṃvṛteḥ satyadarśanaṃ pratyāhāreṇa /

cihnam nāma megha dhūma ādi vat pratibhāsaḥ

original: tantreṣvaparaṃ jvālādibinduparyantaṃ ṣaḍanyanimittaṃ māyājāle samādhipaṭale proktaṃ bhagavatā /

atra prajñā jñāna analaḥ iti jvālā pratibhāsaḥ

original: tathā ḍākinīvajrapañjare bhagavānāha sidhyatyaśeṣaniḥśeṣaṃ traidhātukaṃ carācaram /

original: tathā śrīsamāje bhagavānāha abhāve bhāvanābhāvo bhāvanā naiva bhāvanā /
